text: Hey, I'm glad you picked up. Sorry for calling out of nowhere. I just... I found something, and...
I didn't really want to explain it over text.
Remember that contact list I told you about? The one I found in Daniel's old folder?
I've been going through it again. And there's something I completely missed the first time.
There's a section 4 remarks. Just little notes beside the contacts.
Most of them are empty, but one isn't. It says, don't call this number.
Yeah, that's exactly what it says. No explanation, no name, just those four words.
The strange thing is, the file doesn't look quite right. Some of the details are missing,
and a few entries don't line up properly. I can't even tell for certain which number that
remark belongs to. But there's one number in that section with a little star beside it.
And it's the number I use to contact you.
I know, I know how that sounds. Believe me, I've been staring at it for ages,
trying to make sense of it. I think Daniel might have written that remark,
but I can't prove it. It's just a copy of a file. Someone could have changed it, or maybe I'm reading
it wrong. Daniel was always leaving himself little reminders on scraps of paper, old receipts,
pretty much anything he could find. It used to drive me crazy. But this doesn't feel like one
of his ordinary reminders. I can't imagine why he'd tell himself not to call someone.
Can I ask you something?
Since I first contacted you, has anyone else reached out to you about Daniel? Anyone you didn't
recognize? It's okay if you'd rather not say. I know you've already been dragged into something
you never asked to be part of. I just need you to be careful. If someone contacts you from a number
looking into this, not until we understand what that remark means. I've been so desperate to find
my brother that I never really stopped to think about you. You were just a stranger when I messaged
you. And now I'm asking you to help me make sense of something. I barely understand myself.
I'm sorry. Really. You didn't deserve to be put in this position.
I can send you the export, the actual copy I have, not just a screenshot. Maybe you'll notice
something I haven't. I don't want you taking my word for any of this. But please, let's not
share everyone's contact details with the group. Some of those numbers belong to people
who have nothing to do with Daniel disappearing. We should be careful about that.
Maya's already worried enough. And Lucas, well, you saw how he reacted to you being in the group.
I don't think showing everyone a strange warning without knowing what it means is going to help.
There's something else I want to check. Daniel kept some old papers in the same folder.
I remember seeing them, but I haven't gone through everything properly. I'm going to look again,
carefully this time. Maybe there's something that explains the remark. Or at least tells us whether
Daniel actually wrote it. You know what's really bothering me? I called you because I
thought that number might help us find him. And now? I don't even know whether I was supposed
to call it in the first place. I keep telling myself it could mean absolutely nothing.
Just an old note, or some mistake in the file. But every time I try to convince myself of that,
I think about Daniel and how he just disappeared. I don't want to jump to conclusions. I just
I don't want to make another mistake. Thank you for listening. I'll send you the
file so you can look at it yourself. And if you find anything strange,
will you tell me? Okay. I'll check those papers and let you know what I find. And please, be careful.
Talk soon. Bye.
